mechanism: Rifampin induces CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9), increasing metabolism of allopurinol's active metabolite alloxanthine and reducing serum uric acid-lowering efficacy.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels closely; may require increased allopurinol dosing to maintain therapeutic effect; consider alternative antimycobacterial agent if possible.
